Issue 04:
# 04 — Tag filter + search

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

Add a search bar and tag filter pills above the gallery. Both filter the already-fetched products array in memory — no extra DB calls. Search matches product name, description, and tags. Tag pills are derived from the union of all tags across all products. Filters compose: both search and active pill must match.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Search bar appears above the gallery grid
- [ ] Tag pills are derived dynamically from all products' `tags` arrays (no hardcoded list)
- [ ] Typing in search bar filters products by name, description, or tag in real time
- [ ] Clicking a tag pill filters to products containing that exact tag
- [ ] Active tag pill is visually distinct from inactive pills
- [ ] Multiple tag pills can be selected simultaneously; product must match all selected tags
- [ ] Search and tag filter compose: product must match both
- [ ] Clearing search and deselecting all pills restores the full product list
- [ ] Tests: all filtering combinations above

## Blocked by

- 03 — Product gallery


---

Issue 06:
# 06 — Checkout form + create-payment-intent Edge Function

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

Build the checkout form and the `create-payment-intent` Supabase Edge Function. The form collects customer and shipping details. On submit, it calls the Edge Function which validates the cart server-side, writes a pending order to Supabase, and returns a Stripe `clientSecret`. After this slice the full order record exists in the DB before any payment is taken.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `CheckoutForm` collects: full name, email, street address, city, postal code, country
- [ ] All fields are required; form does not submit if any are empty
- [ ] On submit, form calls `create-payment-intent` Edge Function with cart items and customer data
- [ ] Edge Function fetches product prices from DB — never trusts client-provided prices
- [ ] Edge Function returns 400 if any `product_id` is not found in the DB
- [ ] Edge Function returns 400 if any item has `is_available = false`
- [ ] Edge Function writes one `orders` row with `status: order_received` and all customer/shipping fields
- [ ] Edge Function writes one `order_items` row per cart item with `price_at_purchase` from DB
- [ ] Edge Function creates a Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR and returns `clientSecret`
- [ ] Edge Function does NOT create a Stripe PaymentIntent if any validation fails
- [ ] `VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` configured in the correct environments
- [ ] Tests: all Edge Function validation and DB-write behaviours

## Blocked by

- 01 — Supabase schema + project config
- 05 — Cart + CartDrawer

plan.sprint_goal: Implement client-side tag filter + search on the gallery and build the checkout form with the create-payment-intent Edge Function so a full order record is written to Supabase before payment is taken

dev1.task: Add a search bar and multi-select tag filter pills above the gallery grid in src/pages/Gallery.jsx. Derive tag pills dynamically from the union of all products' tags arrays. Filter the already-fetched products array in memory on every keystroke or pill click. Search must match product name, description, and tags (case-insensitive). Multiple pills may be active simultaneously; a product must match ALL active pills AND the search string. Active pills must be visually distinct. Clearing search and deselecting all pills restores the full list. Also write tests in src/pages/Gallery.test.jsx covering: search by name, search by tag text, single pill filter, multiple pill filter, search+pill composition, and clearing all filters.
dev1.context_needed: src/pages/Gallery.jsx already exists and uses useProducts hook (src/hooks/useProducts.js) which returns { products, loading, error }. Product shape from Supabase: { id, name, description, price (cents), image_url, tags: string[], is_available: boolean }. src/components/ProductCard.jsx accepts product props and onAddToCart callback. CartContext (src/context/CartContext.jsx) exposes addItem(productId, quantity). Do not re-fetch on filter — filter the in-memory array only.

dev2.task: Create the Supabase Edge Function supabase/functions/create-payment-intent/index.ts. It receives POST body: { items: [{ product_id: string, quantity: number }], customer: { name: string, email: string, street: string, city: string, postal_code: string, country: string } }. Steps in order: (1) fetch all referenced product rows from DB using service role key; (2) return 400 if any product_id is not found; (3) return 400 if any product has is_available = false; (4) calculate total in cents from DB prices only — ignore any client-provided price; (5) create Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR with the calculated total; (6) insert one orders row with status='order_received', stripe_payment_id=pi.id, total, and all customer/shipping fields; (7) insert one order_items row per item with price_at_purchase from DB; (8) return { clientSecret: pi.client_secret }. Do NOT create the PaymentIntent if any validation step fails. Also write tests in supabase/functions/create-payment-intent/index.test.ts covering all acceptance criteria: unavailable product returns 400, missing product_id returns 400, total calculated from DB prices, correct orders row written, correct order_items rows written, clientSecret returned on success, no PI created on validation failure.
dev2.context_needed: DB schema: orders table has columns (id uuid, stripe_payment_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT, total INTEGER, customer_name TEXT, customer_email TEXT, shipping_street TEXT, shipping_city TEXT, shipping_postal_code TEXT, shipping_country TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ). order_items table has (id uuid, order_id uuid FK, product_id uuid FK, quantity INTEGER, price_at_purchase INTEGER). products table has (id uuid, name TEXT, description TEXT, price INTEGER, image_url TEXT, tags TEXT[], is_available BOOLEAN DEFAULT true). Use Supabase service role key (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env var) for all DB writes. Use STRIPE_SECRET_KEY env var for Stripe — both are set in Supabase dashboard at runtime. CartContext items shape for reference: [{ id, name, price, image_url, quantity }] but Edge Function must ignore client price. stripe_payment_id ordering: validate products first, create PI, insert orders row with pi.id, insert order_items.

plan.shared_types: CartItem: { id: string; name: string; price: number; image_url: string; quantity: number }. CreatePaymentIntentRequest: { items: Array<{ product_id: string; quantity: number }>; customer: { name: string; email: string; street: string; city: string; postal_code: string; country: string } }. CreatePaymentIntentResponse: { clientSecret: string }. Product (Supabase row): { id: string; name: string; description: string; price: number; image_url: string; tags: string[]; is_available: boolean }. Order status enum: 'order_received' | 'payment_confirmed' | 'order_confirmed' | 'sent' | 'cancelled'.
